tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Fubini-Study metric on $\mathbb {CP}^n$] ↗ def:einstein-manifold

$\mathbb {C}P^{n}$ equipped with the Fubini-Study metric, which is induced from the standard metric of $S^{2n+1}$ under the Hopf fibration with the fibers of great circles, is Einstein. \end{example}
